Situated on a small island called Corregidor in the Luzon Strait separating the Philippines from Taiwan, it boasts an extensive infrastructure that includes several international airports within its vicinity such as Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA). In terms of population density and land area amongst all cities globally, Manila is one of the most densely populated. The city has a rich history dating back to the 9th century when it was established by Rajah Sulayman as an independent settlement which later became part of the Kingdom of Tondo before falling under Spanish colonial rule in late 16th century until Philippine independence at the start of the 2in 1898. Today, Manila is a modern city that combines history with contemporary urban living and holds immense significance to Filipinos both nationally and globally as it has been frequently listed among the world's most liveable cities by various global organizations like Mercer Human Resource Consulting in The Worldwide Cost of Living survey.
